Please read this before you travel

Pet Travel Safety Notice

Travelers need to know that every animal must be ready for check-in with clean gear, safe handling, and the right papers. Aurelia Skyways takes pet safety seriously, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk will look over each case before departure.

For rabbits, the crate and pet must stay within the carrier limit, and the booking team may refuse travel if the setup looks unsafe. <<FACT F064>> <<FACT F058>> Keep the rabbit calm, dry, and easy to lift, and do not crowd the crate with loose items. A welfare coordinator reviews comfort needs and can flag risks fast.

For reptiles, the health certificate must be current and easy to show at the desk. <<FACT F084>> Bring it with the animal, not packed away in luggage, so the staff can check it without delay. If anything seems unclear, stop and ask before you leave home, because missing papers can slow the trip or stop boarding.

For all companion animals, use a secure carrier, offer water when safe, and arrive prepared for screening. Talk with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you go so problems can be caught early and fixed in time.
